insert-text.xml:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<fmxmlsnippet type="FMObjectList">
  <Step enable="False" id="61" name="Insert Text">
    <SelectAll state="False"/>
    <Text/>
    <Field>$README</Field>
    <Text>CALLED BY: companion server /trigger endpoint via AppleScript  The companion sets the job via POST /pending before firing do script.  This script GETs /pending to retrieve: target (script name), auto_save (bool), select_all (bool).PARAMETERS (from /pending JSON):  target      — name of the script to paste into  auto_save   — if true, saves all scripts after paste  select_all  — if true (default), runs Select All before paste (replaces all steps)               if false, pastes after existing steps (append mode)RETURNS: JSON { success, script, auto_save, select_all } or { success, error }REQUIRES: MBS Plugin with ScriptWorkspace and Menubar functionsWARNING: FileMaker will block script execution with a dialog if any scripts have  unsaved changes. Ensure Agentic-fm Paste itself is saved before running deployments.  auto_save uses "Save All Scripts" which saves all open scripts in the workspace.NOTE: Replace sequence is Cmd+A → Delete (key code 51) → Cmd+V.  The Script Workspace does NOT overwrite a selection on paste — selected steps  must be explicitly deleted before pasting or the new steps are appended.  System Events keystrokes are used (not MBS Menubar commands) because MBS  commands are panel-focus-sensitive and unreliable in the Script Workspace.DIAGNOSTIC: If you hear a system beep after a deploy with auto_save enabled,  the paste likely failed — Cmd+S beeps when the script has no unsaved changes.</Text>
  </Step>
</fmxmlsnippet>
